description.p: Each tab pairs a shell with a file explorer. When the shell connects to another machine over SSH, the explorer follows it to the same host and account: shell, files, transfers, text editing and permissions in one tab.

ul.li: An SSH-aware file explorer in the style of Thunar, with a built-in text editor
MultiExec, which types into several terminals at once
Administrator mode, for working on files as root
Tailcat pairing, for reaching machines that can't reach each other by IP
